items.prompt: Should students have homework every night or no homework? Choose one side. Write a complete opinion sentence with your choice and a reason.
items.answer: I think students should not have homework every night because they need time to rest and play after school.

steps: Pick a side.
Start with 'I think' or 'I believe.'
State your choice.
Add 'because' and one reason.

items.prompt:
Read these two sentences. Which one is a stronger opinion sentence and why?

A) I think rain is bad.
B) I think rainy days are fun because you can jump in puddles and read inside.
items.answer: B is stronger because it gives a specific reason ('you can jump in puddles and read inside') that supports the opinion.

steps: A gives an opinion but no reason. B gives the same opinion with two specific reasons. More detail makes an opinion stronger.

items.prompt: A student writes: 'I like going to the library. Books are on the shelves.' Does this paragraph state an opinion? Rewrite the first sentence as a strong opinion sentence.
items.answer: I think the library is the best place in school because it has so many books to explore.

steps: 'I like going to the library' is a preference but not a full opinion sentence.
Add an opinion word, name the topic clearly, and give a reason with 'because.'

items.prompt:
Write one sentence that states the opinion and one sentence that gives a reason:

Topic: playing outside vs. watching TV
items.answer: I think playing outside is better than watching TV. Playing outside is better because you get exercise and fresh air.

steps: Sentence 1 states the opinion: 'I think playing outside is better than watching TV.'
Sentence 2 gives the reason: 'Playing outside is better because you get exercise and fresh air.'

items.prompt:
Which closing sentence fits this opinion paragraph?

'I think we should have a class pet. A pet would teach us to be responsible and caring.'

A) Pets can be cats or dogs.
B) That is why I believe every classroom should have a pet.
items.answer: B) That is why I believe every classroom should have a pet.

steps: A closing sentence wraps up the paragraph. Sentence A introduces a new fact. Sentence B restates the opinion and signals the end.

items.prompt:
Improve this opinion sentence by adding a second reason:

'I think spring is the best season because flowers bloom.'

Add another reason starting with 'Also, ...'
items.answer: I think spring is the best season because flowers bloom. Also, the weather is warm and perfect for playing outside.

steps: Keep the original sentence.
Add 'Also,' to start a second supporting idea.
Make sure the new reason connects to spring being the best season.

items.prompt:
Which sentence gives TWO reasons for the opinion?

A) I think apples are great because they are sweet.
B) I think apples are great because they are sweet and they are also healthy to eat.
items.answer: B) I think apples are great because they are sweet and they are also healthy to eat.

steps: Count the reasons: A has one reason (sweet). B has two reasons (sweet AND healthy). Two reasons make B stronger.

items.prompt: Your teacher asks: 'Should the class get a fish or a rabbit as a class pet?' Pick one. Write your opinion sentence and one supporting reason.
items.answer: I think the class should get a fish because fish are quiet and easy to take care of.

steps: Choose one animal.
Start with 'I think the class should get a...'
Add 'because' and a reason why that animal is a better choice.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'I believe learning to swim is important. That is why all kids should learn.' What is missing from this opinion paragraph?
items.answer: The paragraph is missing a reason. It has an opinion and a closing but does not explain WHY learning to swim is important.

steps: Check for: opinion word (yes, 'I believe'), reason (missing), closing (yes, 'That is why...').
A reason should explain why learning to swim is important, for example 'because it keeps you safe near water.'

items.prompt:
Finish this paragraph by adding a reason and a closing sentence:

'I think lunch is the best part of school. _____. _____.'
items.answer: I think lunch is the best part of school. Lunch is the best because I get to eat my favorite food and sit with my friends. That is why lunch should be longer every day.

steps: Sentence 2 gives a reason starting with 'because.'
Sentence 3 is a closing that wraps up the opinion.

items.prompt:
Which two sentences work best together as an opinion paragraph?

A) I think we should have more art class. Art is on Tuesdays.
B) I think we should have more art class. Art helps us be creative and express our feelings.
items.answer: B) The two sentences in B work together because the second sentence gives a reason that supports the opinion in the first sentence.

steps: Check if the second sentence supports the first with a reason or evidence.
In B, 'Art helps us be creative and express our feelings' directly explains why we should have more art class.

items.prompt: Write a short opinion paragraph (2 sentences) about whether it is better to read alone or with a partner. Include an opinion and a reason.
items.answer: I think reading with a partner is better because you can help each other with hard words. Reading together also makes it more fun.

steps: Sentence 1: opinion + reason using 'because.'
Sentence 2: add another reason or detail.

items.prompt: A student's opinion sentence is: 'I think the school should have a garden because plants are nice.' How could this reason be stronger?
items.answer: A stronger reason would be: 'I think the school should have a garden because students can grow their own food and learn about nature.'

steps: 'Plants are nice' is a weak reason because it does not explain what students gain.
A stronger reason tells a specific benefit, like learning about nature or growing food.

items.prompt:
Circle the closing sentence:

'I think we should have a longer school day. With more time we could do more science and art. That is why a longer school day would help us learn more.'
items.answer: That is why a longer school day would help us learn more.

steps: The closing sentence is usually the last one.
It often starts with 'That is why' or 'In conclusion' and wraps up the idea.

items.prompt: Write a full opinion paragraph about whether school should start later in the morning. Include: opinion, reason, closing.
items.answer: I think school should start later in the morning because kids need more sleep to do their best learning. When students are not tired, they can pay attention better. That is why starting school later would help everyone.

steps: Sentence 1: 'I think school should start later because...'
Sentence 2: expand on the reason or add another.
Sentence 3: closing sentence that restates the opinion.
